scope: coordinator Chromium desktop/mobile against pre-knowledge-refresh production build on localhost:3100; launch outside sandbox

cases.title: anonymous conversation uses the real server and official links
all six entry points are present and clarification preserves an ordinal follow-up
loading is announced and rapid Enter cannot duplicate a request
retry preserves the failed turn and does not duplicate history
network failure has a safe retry path
cancelling prevents a late response from appearing and preserves a retry
malformed responses produce a recoverable safe error
model text is inert and only exact approved URLs become links
blank input, multiline entry, and IME composition do not send accidentally
new conversation clears local state without persistence
viewport has no horizontal overflow and primary controls are reachable
long conversations and composer input remain bounded
long inert response remains within the mobile viewport with reduced motion
a new conversation cannot be overwritten by an older in-flight response
reading earlier messages is respected until Jump to latest is used
welcome starts at the top and reset restores that position
keyboard topic activation preserves a stable focus target
keyboard retry preserves focus without duplicating the user turn
client deadline yields a saved draft and does not accept late output
